phase: Phase 19: Autonomous Crash Impact Detection, eCall SOS & Offline Voice Command HUD

stories.title: Pure KMP Crash Detection, Fall-Over IMU State Machine & Countdown Arbiter
stories.description: Implement pure KMP CrashDetector.kt and SensorModels.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/safety/. Detects high-G vehicular impacts (>4.5g / >44.1 m/s²), persistent motorcycle fall-over tilt (>60° for >8 seconds), sudden deceleration spikes (>35 km/h drop in <1.5s), and initiates an autonomous 30-second pre-alert countdown with rider abort/cancel mechanism before dispatching priority SOS packet over the mesh with zero Java or C dependencies (Rules 2 & 3).
acceptanceCriteria: Pure KMP implementation with zero Java, C, or platform-specific sensor dependencies in commonMain (Rules 2 & 3)
Accurately discriminates high-G shock and sustained tilt fall-over while rejecting transient speed bumps
Manages 30-second abortable countdown state machine with audible warning signal triggers
Emits autonomous priority emergency SOS beacon packet with GPS coordinates, peak G-force, and blackbox freeze trigger
100% unit test pass across JVM, Android, and iOS Simulator targets

stories.title: Pure KMP Offline Voice Command & Keyword Spotting DSP Engine
stories.description: Implement pure KMP VoiceCommandRecognizer.kt and VoiceCommandModels.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/audio/. Parses offline keyword voice commands from 48kHz audio streams (e.g. 'Intercom SOS', 'Intercom Next', 'Intercom Prev', 'Intercom Mute', 'Intercom Battery', 'Intercom Status') using acoustic energy envelope template matching and phonetic formant transitions without cloud dependencies or external ML runtimes.
acceptanceCriteria: Zero-cloud offline voice command parser running on 48kHz PCM frames in pure KMP (Rules 2 & 3)
Supports hands-free tactical actions: SOS trigger, channel stepping, mute toggle, and battery status request
Robust noise rejection preventing false command triggers during ambient wind noise
100% unit test pass across JVM, Android, and iOS Simulator targets

stories.title: Subsystem Hardware Bridge Wiring & Multiplatform Emergency HUD Presentation
stories.description: Wire CrashDetector and VoiceCommandRecognizer into Koin DI (AppModule.kt), IntercomHardwareBridge, AndroidPlatformBridge, and IntercomBridge (iosMain) with typed CancellationHandle observers. Integrate 30-second crash countdown banner with 1-tap abort button, audible alarm chime, and voice command recognition feedback badge across Compose Multiplatform (HomeScreen.kt) and 100% Native iOS SwiftUI (ContentView.swift) respecting Rule 1.
acceptanceCriteria: Hardware bridges stream platform IMU accelerometer/gyroscope readings into CrashDetector
Exposes reactive CancellationHandle observers for crash countdown and voice commands on iOS (Rule 1)
Compose Multiplatform renders emergency crash countdown dialog with 1-tap cancel button
100% Native iOS SwiftUI renders tactical countdown card with haptic alarm and abort button (Rule 1)
Full compilation and automated verification pass across all targets

stories.title: Crash Impact & Voice Command Multiplatform Simulation Harness & Benchmark Suite
stories.description: Implement CrashAndVoiceSimulationHarness.kt simulating motorcycle fall-over incidents, high-G collision impulses, road vibration noise profiles, and voice command recognition under simulated 80 km/h wind noise. Verify false-alarm rejection rates, countdown abort semantics, and memory bounds.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulates multi-axis IMU profiles: potholes vs high-G impact vs tip-over fall
Verifies 30s countdown abort safety window and automated SOS beacon dispatch upon countdown expiry
Verifies memory stability and zero coroutine leaks under continuous IMU stream processing
Full test pass and clean release readiness sign-off
